list.name: Tanmoy Bhattacharya
list.role: Solution Architect | Enabling Scalable Data Warehouse Solutions in Retail | Databricks | Data Analytics | TOGAF Certified
list.text: I had the pleasure of working with Nitin on Morrisons Ordering Automation Project where their expertise in Test Automation proved invaluable. He has consistently demonstrated a deep understanding of both functional and automated testing frameworks, along with an exceptional ability to translate complex business requirements into effective, reliable test cases. What sets Nitin apart is not just technical skill, but also his proactive approach to problem-solving, attention to detail, and commitment to quality. Whether it was building robust automation scripts, optimizing existing frameworks, or mentoring junior team members, Nitin brought clarity, efficiency, and a calm professionalism to every task. If you're looking for someone who can elevate your Automation Testing Framework and be a strong team player, I highly recommend Nitin.

list.role: Information Technology Manager at Tata Steel Limited
list.text: Nitin was always a very bright student. He is a quick learner and has a very good understanding of web applications. He has worked on latest technologies like Python and Rest APIs. He is very versatile and is not afraid to take up new challenges and roles. He has a good work exposure in data analysis and automation as well. I wish him good luck in IT industry.

list.relationship: Mayuri worked with Nitin but on different teams
list.text: I recommend Nitin for his exceptional skills in Automation, his dedication to learn new technologies and his ability. His proactive approach and excellent communication skills greatly contribute to successful project outcomes. I have confidence in Nitin's ability to excel in any role requiring a combination of technical expertise and interpersonal finesse. Nitin's innovative thinking and adaptability shine through in challenging situations, showcasing his resilience and ability to thrive under pressure. His commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends positions him as a forward-thinking professional. Nitin's positive attitude and collaborative spirit make him a pleasure to work with, fostering a productive and enjoyable work environment.

list.text: I have had the privilege of collaborating with Nitin on a data-intensive project for the past several months, and I am delighted to provide this recommendation based on his exceptional performance. Despite the challenges of virtual collaboration, Nitin's professionalism and commitment to excellence have consistently stood out.

His work ethic and passion for quality and customer service have had a positive impact on our projects. Nitin consistently delivered tasks ahead of schedule, which greatly contributed to the success of our team.
